name: Ghost Score Alert
response:
<div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; border-radius: 4px;">

<div style="background: #e67e22; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;">

 <h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold;">Ghost Score Alert</h2>

</div>


<div style="padding: 24px; color: #36414c; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6;">

 <p>Hi {{ participant_name }},</p>


 <p>

  Your MeetMind ghost score has reached

  <strong style="font-size: 16px;">

   {{ "%.1f"|format(ghost_score_pct) }}%

  </strong>

  (risk level: <strong>{{ risk_level }}</strong>).

 </p>


 <p>

  A ghost score measures work assigned to you in meetings that never gets done.

  Your current breakdown:

 </p>


 <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 16px 0;">

  <tr>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">

    Total Assigned

   </td>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">

    {{ total_assigned }}

   </td>

  </tr>


  <tr>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">

    Completed

   </td>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">

    {{ total_completed }}

   </td>

  </tr>


  <tr>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">

    Overdue

   </td>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">

    {{ total_overdue }}

   </td>

  </tr>


  <tr>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">

    Ghost (abandoned)

   </td>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">

    {{ total_ghost }}

   </td>

  </tr>


  <tr>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">

    Completion Rate

   </td>

   <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">

    {{ "%.1f"|format(completion_rate_pct) }}%

   </td>

  </tr>

 </table>


 <p>

  Clearing overdue items, or flagging them as cancelled early, is the fastest

  way to bring your score back down.

 </p>


 <p style="margin-top: 24px;">

  <a href="/app/employee-ghost-score"

   style="background: #2490ef; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 18px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block;">

   View Ghost Scores

  </a>

 </p>


 <p style="color: #8d99a6; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 32px;">

  This is an automated alert from MeetMind. It is sent once each time your risk level rises to High or Critical.

 </p>

</div>

</div>
subject: MeetMind Ghost Score Alert - {{ risk_level }}

name: MeetMind Weekly Digest
response:
<div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; border-radius: 4px;">

<div style="background: #2490ef; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;">

<h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold;">MeetMind Weekly Digest</h2>

</div>

<div style="padding: 24px; color: #36414c; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6;">


<h3 style="margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 15px;">This Month</h3>

<p style="margin: 0;">

{{ summary.this_month.meeting_count }} meeting(s) ·

{{ currency }} {{ "%.2f"|format(summary.this_month.meeting_cost) }} spent ·

average health score {{ summary.this_month.average_health_score }}

</p>


<h3 style="margin: 24px 0 8px; font-size: 15px;">Overall Totals</h3>

<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">Meeting Sessions</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ summary.totals.meeting_sessions }}</td>

</tr>

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">Open Action Items</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ summary.totals.open_actions }}</td>

</tr>

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">Overdue Action Items</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ summary.totals.overdue_actions }}</td>

</tr>

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">Ghost Action Items</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ summary.totals.ghost_actions }}</td>

</tr>

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">Zombie Decisions</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ summary.totals.zombie_decisions }}</td>

</tr>

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">High Risk Participants</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ summary.totals.high_risk_participants }}</td>

</tr>

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; background: #f5f7fa;">Active Participants</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ summary.totals.participants }}</td>

</tr>

</table>


{% if summary.department_cost %}

<h3 style="margin: 24px 0 8px; font-size: 15px;">Meeting Cost by Department (this month)</h3>

<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">

<thead>

<tr style="background: #f5f7fa;">

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: left;">Department</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">Cost</th>

</tr>

</thead>

<tbody>

{% for row in summary.department_cost %}

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd;">{{ row.department }}</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ currency }} {{ "%.2f"|format(row.total_cost) }}</td>

</tr>

{% endfor %}

</tbody>

</table>

{% endif %}


{% if summary.meeting_type_distribution %}

<h3 style="margin: 24px 0 8px; font-size: 15px;">Meetings by Type</h3>

<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">

<thead>

<tr style="background: #f5f7fa;">

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: left;">Type</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">Count</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">Cost</th>

</tr>

</thead>

<tbody>

{% for row in summary.meeting_type_distribution %}

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd;">{{ row.meeting_type }}</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ row.count }}</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ currency }} {{ "%.2f"|format(row.total_cost) }}</td>

</tr>

{% endfor %}

</tbody>

</table>

{% endif %}


{% if summary.health_trend %}

<h3 style="margin: 24px 0 8px; font-size: 15px;">Health Score Trend (6 months)</h3>

<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">

<thead>

<tr style="background: #f5f7fa;">

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: left;">Month</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">Meetings</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">Avg Health</th>

</tr>

</thead>

<tbody>

{% for row in summary.health_trend %}

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd;">{{ row.month }}</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ row.meeting_count }}</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ row.average_health_score }}</td>

</tr>

{% endfor %}

</tbody>

</table>

{% endif %}


{% if summary.action_status_breakdown %}

<h3 style="margin: 24px 0 8px; font-size: 15px;">Action Items by Status</h3>

<p style="margin: 0;">

{% for row in summary.action_status_breakdown %}

{{ row.status }}: <strong>{{ row.count }}</strong>{% if not loop.last %} · {% endif %}

{% endfor %}

</p>

{% endif %}


{% if summary.ghost_participants %}

<h3 style="margin: 24px 0 8px; font-size: 15px;">Participants Needing Attention</h3>

<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">

<thead>

<tr style="background: #f5f7fa;">

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: left;">Participant</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: left;">Risk</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">Ghost Score</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">Completion</th>

</tr>

</thead>

<tbody>

{% for row in summary.ghost_participants %}

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd;">{{ row.participant_name }}</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd;">{{ row.risk_level }}</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ "%.1f"|format(row.ghost_score_pct) }}%</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: right;">{{ "%.1f"|format(row.completion_rate_pct) }}%</td>

</tr>

{% endfor %}

</tbody>

</table>

{% endif %}


{% if summary.upcoming_deadlines %}

<h3 style="margin: 24px 0 8px; font-size: 15px;">Deadlines in the Next 7 Days</h3>

<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">

<thead>

<tr style="background: #f5f7fa;">

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: left;">Task</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: left;">Due</th>

<th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; text-align: left;">Priority</th>

</tr>

</thead>

<tbody>

{% for row in summary.upcoming_deadlines %}

<tr>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd;">

<a href="/app/action-item/{{ row.name }}" style="color: #2490ef;">{{ row.task_title }}</a>

</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd;">{{ row.due_date }}</td>

<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd;">{{ row.priority }}</td>

</tr>

{% endfor %}

</tbody>

</table>

{% endif %}


<p style="color: #8d99a6; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 32px;">

This is an automated weekly digest from MeetMind.

</p>

</div>

</div>

name: Zombie Decision Alert
response:
<div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid #d1d8dd; border-radius: 4px;">

<div style="background: #e74c3c; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;">

<h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold;">Zombie Decision Alert</h2>

</div>

<div style="padding: 24px; color: #36414c; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6;">

<p>Hi {{ owner_name }},</p>

<p>

The decision <strong>{{ decision_title }}</strong> ({{ decision_name }})

has been revisited <strong>{{ revisit_count }}</strong> time(s) without reaching

a conclusion. It has now been flagged as a <strong>zombie decision</strong>.

</p>

<p>

Zombie decisions keep coming back to meetings without producing an outcome,

consuming time and cost every cycle. Please close it with a clear resolution

or formally abandon it.

</p>

<p style="margin-top: 24px;">

<a href="/app/decision-log/{{ decision_name }}"

style="background: #2490ef; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 18px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block;">

Open Decision

</a>

</p>

<p style="color: #8d99a6; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 32px;">

This is an automated alert from MeetMind. It is sent once, when the decision is first flagged as a zombie.

</p>

</div>

</div>
response_html:
Zombie Decision Alert

Hi {{ owner_name }},

The decision {{ decision_title }} ({{ decision_name }}) has been revisited {{ revisit_count }} time(s) without reaching a conclusion. It has now been flagged as a zombie decision.

Zombie decisions keep coming back to meetings without producing an outcome, consuming time and cost every cycle. Please close it with a clear resolution or formally abandon it.

Open Decision

This is an automated alert from MeetMind. It is sent once, when the decision is first flagged as a zombie.
